create.name: Zen Life & Meditation Center, Chicago
create.bio:
Zen Life & Meditation Center is a Zen Buddhist community in Oak Park, on the western edge of Chicago, practising in the White Plum Lineage. It was started by a married couple, Robert Joshin Althouse and June Ryushin Tanoue, both Zen teachers with the title Roshi, who still guide it as co-abbots, with the aim of opening the Zen path to anyone whatever their faith, background or gender. Around them has grown a team of ordained priests and lay meditation teachers drawn from the sangha.

The centre's day begins with sitting meditation each weekday morning, and there is a Tuesday evening sitting as well; both can be joined in the meditation hall on Lake Street or over Zoom. Sundays bring a hybrid programme of chanting service, a period of zazen and a talk from a teacher or senior student, followed by tea and conversation. Through the year the centre runs silent, non-residential retreats with talks and private interviews, a four-week course for beginners, monthly gentle yoga to support sitting, council circles and receiving-the-precepts ceremonies. Members support the community by monthly dues, and teachings are offered whether or not someone can pay. Recorded talks by its teachers appear on its YouTube channel.

courses.title: Winter 7/3 Day Retreat, Nov 29 - Dec. 5
courses.description: A silent, non-residential Zen retreat of seven or three days with long periods of sitting, services, dharma talks and one-to-one meetings with teachers. It can be joined at the Oak Park centre or online.

courses.title: Bodhidharma Barebones Retreat - Dec. 27-30
courses.description: A three-day year-end sitting retreat stripped back to the essentials: zazen, walking, meals and work, held in silence without formal services. A few talks are given and short interviews with a Zen teacher are offered.

courses.title: Meditation for Everyone, begins Jan 12
courses.description: A four-evening beginners' course in sitting meditation, open to people of any faith or none. It covers attention to body and breath, the usual obstacles to practice and how to build a daily habit.
courses.price: Early Bird Nonmember $125; Early Bird Member $99

courses.title: Yoga for Meditators
courses.description: A gentle monthly hatha class in the Iyengar style, aimed at a steadier sitting posture and a more settled attention for meditation. It meets on the last Saturday of the month.

courses.title: Membership Practitioner
courses.description: Monthly membership for those who take up Zen training with the community. Members pay reduced fees for retreats and classes.

free_resources.title: Weekly Meditation
free_resources.description: Free group sittings on weekday mornings and Tuesday evenings, in the Oak Park hall or by Zoom, with meditation instruction for newcomers. No experience is needed.

free_resources.title: Sunday Morning Zen
free_resources.description: The weekly Sunday gathering: a chanting service on some weeks, a period of zazen and a talk by a teacher or member, then tea together. Anyone may come in person or by Zoom without booking.
